segments.arabic:
١١٩٧٣- أم الحسن بنت خالد
بن حرام بن خويلد بن أسد بن عبد العزى بن قصيّ.
تقدم ذكرها مع أمها أم حبيب بنت العوام بن خويلد بن أسد، ومقتضى موت والدها قبل أن تدخل الحبشة أن تكون هي التي ولدت بمكة أو بالطريق، فيكون لها عند الوفاة النبويّة أكثر من عشر سنين.
segments.english:
11973—Umm al-Hasan bint Khalid
ibn Haram ibn Khuwaylid ibn Asad ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Qusayy.

She was mentioned above together with her mother, Umm Habib bint al-Awwam ibn Khuwaylid ibn Asad. The fact that her father died before the arrival in Abyssinia implies that she was the one born in Mecca or along the way; she would therefore have been more than ten years old at the Prophet's death.

names.arabic: أم حبيب بنت العوام بن خويلد بن أسد
names.english: Umm Habib bint al-Awwam ibn Khuwaylid ibn Asad

unresolved.explanation: The feminine subject of “entered Abyssinia” is unexpressed and could refer either to Umm al-Hasan or to her mother, Umm Habib. Neither the Urdu witness nor the collateral context safely identifies it, so the final English preserves the ambiguity with “before the arrival in Abyssinia.”
